A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete research work, including Appendices A–F. All 25 pages are readable; pages 2–25 have identical extracted text and rendered content.

before.justification: v1 reports original continual instruction-tuning experiments, function-vector interventions, and method comparisons in Tables 1–2 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main experiments and the supplementary comparisons and interventions in Appendix F.

M1.justification: Function-vector extraction, the consistency and KL losses, and the training procedure are identical in Sections 2.2 and 6 and Appendices A–B.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SuperNI sequences, TRACE tasks, general evaluation datasets, and Appendix F intervention tasks. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same LoraInc, EWC, O-LoRA, and InsCL comparisons. Appendix F retains Model Averaging and the same similarity-measure and random-vector comparisons.

E3.justification: The model configurations, training budgets, task sequences, evaluation samples, metrics, and zero-shot/5-shot evaluation protocols are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: The FV interventions, correlation analyses, model-averaging analysis, random-vector controls, and attention-head tracking are identical, including Appendix F and Figures 6–10.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Figure 6's correlation plots and shaded bands. No seed, repeated-run, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported numerical values and qualitative findings are unchanged. This includes the main results in Tables 1–2 and supplementary results in Tables 7–8 and Appendix F figures.

T1.justification: The FV definitions, latent-variable formulation, mathematical reasoning, and loss expressions are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about model-dependent forgetting, biased function activation, and mitigation through function-vector-guided training.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including the proposed gradient-conflict explanation for InsCL performance drops and the Object Count exception to FV–performance correlation.

D1.justification: Appendices A–E retain identical algorithms, prompts, hyperparameters, hardware details, and FV head selections. Embedded links and the abstract's promise of future code release are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 7, the reference list, and the positioning relative to prior forgetting and mechanistic-interpretability research are identical.

P1.justification: Page 1 corrects the author name from 'Yin Wei' to 'Ying Wei' and updates the arXiv stamp from v1, 16 February 2025, to v2, 16 April 2025. The prose and section structure are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, equations, and their placement are unchanged. The first-page text corrections do not alter the document layout.

improvement.justification: The author-name correction improves attribution accuracy, but the scientific content, presentation, reproducibility information, and appendices remain unchanged. This isolated editorial correction and updated arXiv stamp do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
